WHY KOVA ASKS
Some medication changes your numbers. Beta blockers lower your heart rate. Stimulants change HRV and sleep. If Kova sees something odd that your list explains, it will say so instead of worrying you.
Kova is not a doctor. It just stores what you enter and reminds you. Your dose and timing come from your doctor or pharmacist. If it is urgent, call them.

WHAT HRV IS
The gap between heartbeats is never identical. More variation means your recovery system is in charge. Less means stress, illness or fatigue is. Only your own trend matters. Never compare it to someone else.

WHAT TODAY ASKS FOR

SETTLING
Sound fades up when it is time to wake.
+5 min
End nap
HOW LONG
The window you skip
Between roughly half an hour and an hour you are in deep sleep. Waking out of it is what causes the fog people blame on naps in general.
0 min306090
SOUND WHILE YOU NAP
Your usual mix
Plays while you nap, fades up to wake you
HOW IT WAKES YOU
Coffee nap
Drink it right before you lie down. Caffeine lands in about 25 minutes, which is roughly when you wake.
Silent wake
No alarm out loud. The sound fades up in your headphones and your phone buzzes. For napping where a ringtone would not be welcome.
Sleep buffer
Start the count when you are likely asleep, not when you tap.
RECENT NAPS
WHY THESE LENGTHS
Ten to twenty minutes keeps you in light sleep, so you wake clear. Ninety minutes is one whole cycle, so you surface from light sleep again at the other end. The gap between them lands you in deep sleep, which is the one place waking up hurts. A nap also spends some of the pressure that makes you sleepy tonight, which is why Kova gives you a cutoff rather than leaving it open. And if you never actually drop off, the time still counts — lying down with your eyes shut carries most of the benefit on its own, so Kova logs it as rest rather than as nothing.
